title: DAFormer: Improving Network Architectures and Training Strategies for Domain-Adaptive Semantic Segmentation (Rare Class Sampling)
mechanism: Rare Class Sampling: draw a class c with P(c)=softmax((1-f_c)/T), T=0.01, then draw a uniform image containing c, so images with rare classes are seen far more often.
evidence: Table 5 ablation, GTA to Cityscapes, SegFormer: no RCS 58.2, class-balanced (T=inf) 62.0, RCS T=0.01 64.0 mIoU (+5.8). Largest gains on rare classes rider, train, motorcycle, bicycle. Source set is about 25k synthetic images.
adaptation: Compute f_c from the 478 train masks over the 24 classes, using only classes present in at least 3 cells. Cap any single cell at 10x its uniform draw rate so the 42 inactive cells do not overfit. Keep label-safe augmentation and the 20k steps. This should mainly lift inactive, splice, gridline, edge_dark and material, plus the BMRK cells that carry inactive.
min_experiment: PF+RCS vs PF, 5 seeds each. Metrics: module-grouped 5-fold CV inactive IoU, test mIoU_rob, splice and gridline IoU, with test crack IoU as a guard. Kill if CV inactive gain < +0.02 and mIoU_rob gain < +0.005, or if crack IoU drops by more than 0.012. About 31 GPU-h.
prior_overlap: none. The handbook records no oversampling or class-aware sampling run; the house sampler is uniform.

alt_notes.adaptation: f_c = fraction of the 478 train cells containing class c (splice 53, inactive 42, edge_dark 41). T in {0.1, 0.01}. Fixed 20k steps so the iteration budget is matched. Also usable later to oversample half-cut synthetic views for E1.
alt_notes.min_experiment: Arm: RCS T=0.01, 5 seeds, 20k steps; baseline SUP100; metric mIoU_rob and inactive IoU; kill if mIoU_rob < +0.01 and inactive n.d.

alt_notes.adaptation: f_c over 24 classes from the 478 train masks; candidates only classes in >= 3 train cells; cap any cell's draw rate at 10x uniform so the 42 inactive cells are not memorised; same 20k steps, label-safe augmentation unchanged.
alt_notes.min_experiment: PF+RCS vs PF, 5 seeds; metrics module-grouped CV inactive IoU, test mIoU_rob, splice/gridline IoU, crack IoU guard. Kill: CV inactive < +0.02 and mIoU_rob < +0.005, or crack IoU drop > 0.012.
